column3: MT 102:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; כִי־ יַעֲטֹף (“when he faints”) is rendered “when he is overwhelmed.”
Close to the Hebrew; “come to an end in smoke” is rendered “consumed like smoke.”
Close to the Hebrew; לִבְשָׂרִי (“to my flesh”) is rendered “to my skin.”
Close to the Hebrew; the bird names are rendered “a pelican of the wilderness” and “an owl of the desert”; the identifications are uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; כְּצִפּוֹר (“a bird”) is rendered “a sparrow.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they swear by me” is rendered “swear an oath against me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you sit [enthroned]” is rendered “shall endure,” and NKJV supplies “Your name.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV renders the perfect verbs as future (“shall build up… shall appear”).
Close to the Hebrew; “the height of his holiness” is rendered “the height of His sanctuary.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the sons of death” is rendered “those appointed to death.”
Close to the Hebrew; אַל־ תַּעֲלֵנִי (“do not take me up”) is rendered “Do not take me away.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you are he” is rendered “You are the same.”
Close to the Hebrew; יִשְׁכּוֹנוּ (“will dwell”) is rendered “will continue.”
